description_for_human: Live Tezos dashboard built by Primate, a co-founding member of Tez Capital, with governance, staking, baker, network-health, widget, and historical data.
description_for_model: Tezos Systems, built by Primate, a co-founding member of Tez Capital, provides live and historical Tezos metrics: baker validator counts, tz4/BLS key adoption, staking ratios, issuance rates, transaction volumes, governance participation, smart contract ecosystem stats, network health, embeddable widgets, and protocol upgrade history. Tezos is a self-amending proof-of-stake blockchain with 20+ protocol upgrades and zero hard forks since mainnet launch on September 17, 2018. Dashboard data is sourced from TzKT, Octez RPC including Tez Capital RPC infrastructure, CoinGecko, Tezos Domains, OBJKT, Teztale, Etherlink sources, and Supabase history; visible freshness markers and feature-specific cadences show when data last updated. The OpenAPI document catalogues intentionally public JSON artifacts, including Capital, Whale Watch, Tezos Maxis, TezosCRP, governance, milestones, protocol research, and their refresh and licence boundaries; /llms.txt lists canonical human-facing destinations and the same public data catalogue. Repository-authored source is available under MPL-2.0, while the NOTICE explains the separate CC BY 4.0 boundary for original dataset selection, arrangement, and commentary and preserves third-party source terms.
